llms.body:
# Zoom Earth

> Zoom Earth is an interactive weather map (satellite imagery, rain radar, and model-based forecasts) with hurricane and tropical cyclone tracking, wildfire monitoring, and place-based weather pages.

This file highlights canonical human-facing pages and common user intents. For broad crawling of dynamic content (places, storms, fires), start with the sitemap files.

## Use Zoom Earth For

- Live satellite map, satellite animation loop, cloud cover, smoke, fog, storms
- Weather radar, rain radar, precipitation radar, rain and snow map, short-term radar forecast (nowcast)
- Hurricane tracker, tropical cyclone tracker, typhoon tracker, storm tracker
- Wildfire map, active fires, heat spots, wildfire smoke
- Forecast maps: precipitation and clouds, wind speed, wind gusts, temperature, heat index, wet-bulb temperature, humidity, dew point, pressure
- Local weather by place (cities, regions, countries)

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://zoom.earth/): Main interactive weather map.
- [Contact](https://zoom.earth/contact/): Support and feedback form.

## Observational Maps (Satellite and Radar)

- [Satellite](https://zoom.earth/maps/satellite/): Near real-time satellite imagery from geostationary satellites.
- [HD Satellite](https://zoom.earth/maps/satellite-hd/): Higher-detail NASA satellite imagery updated daily.
- [Radar](https://zoom.earth/maps/radar/): Near real-time precipitation radar map (rain and snow).

## Model Forecast Maps

- [Precipitation](https://zoom.earth/maps/precipitation/): Forecast rain and snow.
- [Wind Speed](https://zoom.earth/maps/wind-speed/): Forecast surface wind speed.
- [Wind Gusts](https://zoom.earth/maps/wind-gusts/): Forecast wind gust speed.
- [Temperature](https://zoom.earth/maps/temperature/): Forecast air temperature.
- [Feels Like Temperature](https://zoom.earth/maps/temperature-feel/): Forecast apparent temperature (heat index).
- [Wet-Bulb Temperature](https://zoom.earth/maps/temperature-wet-bulb/): Forecast heat-stress indicator.
- [Humidity](https://zoom.earth/maps/humidity/): Forecast relative humidity.
- [Dew Point](https://zoom.earth/maps/dew-point/): Forecast dew point.
- [Pressure](https://zoom.earth/maps/pressure/): Forecast mean sea-level pressure.

## Dynamic Collections

- [Root Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap.xml): Entry point for all sitemaps.
- [Maps Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap-maps.xml): Canonical map-layer URLs.
- [Place Pages Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap-places.xml): Canonical place URLs in `/places/{country}/` and `/places/{country}/{place}/`.
- [Tropical Cyclone Pages Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap-storms.xml): Canonical storm URLs in `/storms/{storm-name}-{storm-season}/`.
- [Fire Pages Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap-fires.xml): Canonical fire URLs in `/fires/{fire-id}/`.
- [Legal Sitemap](https://zoom.earth/sitemap-legal.xml): Legal page URLs.

## Example Dynamic Pages

- [Tropical Cyclone Example](https://zoom.earth/storms/paul-2024/): Example tropical cyclone tracking page.
- [Place Example](https://zoom.earth/places/united-states/new-york/): Example place forecast page.
- [Fire Example](https://zoom.earth/fires/us-big-fire/): Example wildfire page.

## Policies and Sources

- [Radar Sources](https://zoom.earth/legal/radar/): Radar provider details by country.
- [Terms of Service](https://zoom.earth/legal/terms/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://zoom.earth/legal/privacy/)
- [Cookie Policy](https://zoom.earth/legal/cookies/)

## Data Sources (High Level)

- Satellite imagery: NOAA `GOES`, EUMETSAT `Meteosat`, JMA `Himawari`, KAI `Geo-KOMPSAT`; HD imagery from NASA `Aqua` and `Terra`
- Forecast models: DWD `ICON`, NOAA/NCEP `GFS`
- Tropical systems: `NHC`, `JTWC`, `NRL`, `IBTrACS`
- Fires/heat spots: NASA `FIRMS`
- Map labels: `OpenStreetMap`

## Notes

- Satellite and radar layers are observational products; forecast layers are model-generated output.
- Weather, satellite, radar, storm, and fire data change frequently; prefer canonical URLs from sitemaps.

Interactive weather & radar map. Track hurricanes, cyclones, storms. View LIVE satellite images, rain maps, forecast maps of wind, temperature for your location.

Mobile App

Download the Zoom Earth app!

Scan the QR code with the camera on your mobile device to get the Zoom Earth app.

Available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad, and on Google Play for Android.

Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD ICON and NOAA/NCEP/NWS GFS.

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological sources around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by NOAA GOES, EUMETSAT Meteosat, and JMA Himawari geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites Aqua and Terra, using services from GIBS, part of EOSDIS.

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from NHC, JTWC, NRL, and IBTrACS.

Active fire incident data is compiled from NIFC, CIFFC, CEMS, EFFIS, GDACS, and other official sources worldwide.

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE FIRMS.

Map labels © OpenStreetMap contributors.

Contact

Please use our contact form to send us your comments, questions, or suggestions.

© 2026 Neave Interactive Ltd.

Terms of Service

Privacy Policy

Heat Spots

Heat spots are not live! Detections are updated daily and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the approximate locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as hot smoke or agriculture.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

Do not use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always refer to local authorities for the latest information.

Track the weather in real time with the Zoom Earth app.

Download App

Welcome! Let’s start by finding your location on the map.
